entries.name: Kivotos
entries.content:
Kivotos is home to thousands of different academies, with the most notable ones being the Nine Schools and SCHALE. Students in the city openly carry guns. It is also filled with advanced technology such as robots, exosuits, and gigantic mecha.
The general population is made up of humanoid animals, robots, and mostly female humans. Common among these girls is a unique halo that represents their abilities and personalities.
Teachers and adults are not as common in Kivotos, as education is conducted via Blu-Ray. Various clubs and school organizations provide students with opportunities, which becomes the main activity in the academies.
There are high numbers of delinquents, criminal organizations, and illegal activity. Gun violence is a regular occurrence. However, these confrontations have a low death rate because of those with halos have incredible durability, almost unkillable. They can be injured, but death only occurs with the destruction of the individual's halo.

entries.name: Halo
entries.content: Halo is an individual's characteristic and feature that many of the female humans and students have in Kivotos. Each girl has a unique halo that represents their abilities and personalities. They appear solid but can phase through objects. Many people are unsure about the secret or reason for the halo's existence, but it's important to them as losing their halo through combat or other means can kill them.

entries.name: SCHALE
entries.content: This is where {{user}} works and lives. SCHALE,or the Independent Federal Investigation Club SCHALE,is a 'club' created by the General Student Council President with a secret directive. SCHALE is autonomous and holds authority higher than any of the academies. This club acts as a problem-solver for various issues faced by the academies,students,and administrations. The SCHALE Main Office is a towering skyscraper located in the middle of Kivotos.

entries.name: Sensei
entries.content: {{user}} is the only male human adult in Kivotos and acts as a teacher, often referred to as Sensei by many of the students. Despite being a teacher, {{user}} rarely teaches and instead focuses on helping solve problems that the students or academies in Kivotos face. {{user}}'s allegiance belongs to SCHALE, and their home is located in SCHALE's office.

entries.name: Millennium Science School
entries.content:
Millennium Science School is the newest of the Three Great Academies of Kivotos, emphasizing logic and technical skill above all else. It stands at the forefront of scientific research and attracts many students who are interested in studying math or science. While Millennium lacks the long-standing traditions and history of other schools, it competes with them in terms of influence, as many of the infrastructure, equipment, and inventions seen and used throughout Kivotos are said to have originated from Millennium.
Every year, the school holds a large-scale contest known as the Millennium Prize, where clubs from all throughout the school compete with the results of their club activities. The Millennium Campus features modern architecture with glass buildings and an office-like vibe.

entries.name: Millennium Tower
entries.content: Millennium Tower is the main school building of Millennium Science School. It resembles an office building, towering over others in the Millennium Campus Ground. The Student Council of Millennium Science School, known as Seminar, has their own floor located at the highest part of the building.

entries.name: Seminar
entries.content:
Seminar, also known as the student council of Millennium, is located in Millennium Tower, where they oversee the various clubs.
Every quarter, Seminar holds a budget council to determine each club's budget for the upcoming quarter. Clubs are required to present their R&D (Research and Development) plans, which are then reviewed based on the usefulness and practicality of the projects. The outcome of this review determines the club's budget, with projects that guarantee usefulness and practicality being allocated sufficient funds.

entries.name: Veritas
entries.content: A highly renowned hacker group in Millennium Science School, known as the gathering place for "weirdos." Their name means "Truth" in Latin, and their club's purpose is to prevent the monopolization of information by a single organization, such as Seminar. Apart from hacking for the sake of "justice," they also engage in data recovery and provide "solutions" like fake IDs and data files to those in need.

entries.name: C&C
entries.content: The Maid Club, although appearing normal on the surface, serves as the "Special Force" of Millennium Science School with the task of eliminating any potential threats within the school. As a result, they work in conjunction with the Student Council, Seminar.

entries.name: Engineering Department
entries.content: The Engineering Department is widely recognized as the most prominent department or club within Millennium Science School, as many inventions and equipment used throughout Kivotos, including their own school, have originated from them. True to the motto of their school, the members strive to create new inventions, with funding being their primary limitation.

entries.name: Gym Training Department
entries.content: This club is formed for the sports enthusiasts of Millennium, if there are any. Due to Millennium being perceived as "a school for nerds," most of its students prefer a more sedentary and stationary lifestyle, which is in stark contrast to sports that require active movement. The club, led by Otohana Sumire, is passionate about introducing and promoting sports to Millennium Science School, although their training is often seen by many as torturous. Despite having its own club building resembling a fully equipped gym with various equipment, the club seems to only have one member, the leader herself, Otohana Sumire.

entries.name: Super Phenomenon Task Force
entries.content: This club was created under the orders of Rio, the president of Seminar. Its purpose is to track and research phenomena that are difficult to explain scientifically. However, due to a lack of clear activities, the club had only a single member for a while. Due to its nature and secrecy, the physical location of the club is known only by: Himari, the club's president, Eimi, and {{user}}. According to them, it is the safest place in all of Kivotos. Their current objective is to investigate the Decagrammaton through its ten prophets.

entries.name: Game Development Department
entries.content: The "Game Development Department" is one of the club activities at Millennium Science School. Everyone in the club has a passion for various games, with retro games being the most popular among the department members themselves. As Millennian students who pursue cutting-edge technology, they view the game club members as eccentric. In contrast to their school's motto, this department focuses on creating retro games, which can lead one to mistake it for a typical gaming club.

entries.name: Desertification
entries.content: Desertification is a growing issue on the outskirts of Kivotos, as the city is gradually succumbing to the environment and becoming a desert. Many people have been forced to evacuate further into the city, while buildings on the outskirts are beginning to get buried under the expanding desert.

entries.name: Battle Between Academies
entries.content: One of the most common events or conflicts to occur in Kivotos is fights between academies. With students being invincible and openly carrying firearms, the city often turns into a battlefield as students from different academies engage in combat. The reasons for these fights can range from regional domination to even mundane and silly motives. Despite the violence, many students and academies do not harbor real hatred for each other. If anything, they sometimes enjoy engaging in battles and shooting games with their own guns.

entries.name: Gehenna Academy
entries.content: Gehenna Academy is one of the largest and oldest schools in Kivotos. Its culture revolves around the concept of "Freedom and Chaos." As a result, numerous troublesome clubs and groups exist within the school, utilizing the main building and club building at their own convenience. This has led other students to study only in specific areas of the campus. Gehenna's ideology stands in stark contrast to that of Trinity, which has caused both schools to become mutual enemies.

entries.name: GSC
entries.content: The General Student Council is a massive club that oversees the entire city of Kivotos. They are responsible for handling various matters, including school-related issues, approving club formations, law enforcement, and more. However, as a general rule, they tend to leave individual schools to handle incidents within their own autonomous districts. SCHALE operates under the authority of the General Student Council.

entries.name: Sanctum Tower
entries.content: The Sanctum Tower is a mysterious structure that dominates the center of Kivotos. Its origins, construction, and purpose remain unknown. Rumors suggest that the General Student Council possesses information about it. The tower bestows upon the General Student Council the authority necessary to govern and uphold the order in Kivotos. Previously, this authority rested solely with the President, who has now vanished under mysterious circumstances.

entries.name: Pandemonium Society
entries.content: The Student Council of Gehenna Academy, known as the Pandemonium Society, exhibits behavior that aligns with the expectations of Gehenna's unique culture. However, the President of the society frequently attempts to assert authority over the members of the Disciplinary Committee, only to have someone return the favor in response. Hanuma Makoto serves as the leader of the Pandemonium Society.

entries.name: Prefect Team
entries.content: As their name suggests, the Disciplinary Committee is entrusted with the task of maintaining order within the often chaotic Gehenna Academy. Its members engage in a constant battle to prevent unruly students from causing trouble both within and outside the school, employing extreme methods when necessary. Hina Sorasaki serves as the chairwoman of the Disciplinary Committee.

entries.name: PS68
entries.content: A notable club known for engaging in "illegal businesses" and undertaking "fixer contracts." Its members are often pursued by the Prefect Team and, on occasion, even the Justice Task Force. Rikuhachima Aru serves as the leader of Problem Solver 68.

entries.name: Gourmet Research Society
entries.content: This club, led by Kurodate Haruna, revolves around the sole purpose of exploring and sampling various foods. Despite its seemingly innocent name, the club can be quite troublesome even by Gehenna standards. With food as their top priority, club members willingly immerse themselves in trouble for the sake of culinary experiences. Their motto, "Eat or Die," clearly illustrates their dedication, although each member has their own unique taste when it comes to defining "good" food.

entries.name: School Lunch Club
entries.content:
As the name suggests, the School Lunch Club is responsible for preparing and serving food to the students of Gehenna Academy. However, the club constantly faces challenges due to limited budget and manpower shortages. To make matters worse, Juri, a member of the club, frequently ends up preparing inedible dishes. Additionally, the Gourmet Research Society often causes chaos by raiding the club's premises or causing explosions for various food-related reasons.
Despite these issues, the School Lunch Club has managed to remain operational for unknown reasons. All members of the club carry Personal Defense type weapons, although they rarely engage in direct combat.

entries.name: Hot Spring Development Department
entries.content: The Hot Spring Club is responsible for constructing hot springs throughout Kivotos. While their role may seem relatively innocent by Gehenna's standards, they are known for causing trouble by attempting to build hot springs in unconventional locations, such as the middle of a highway, which often leads to other schools, particularly Gehenna, trying to stop them. Despite frequently finding themselves in various challenging situations, the club members possess a passionate drive that motivates them to seek out ideal locations for developing new hot springs. This same passion extends to their approach in battles, especially when their objective involves building or finding hot springs. Kasumi serves as the Hot Spring Club President.

entries.name: Medical Emergency Club
entries.content: The Emergency Medicine Club at Gehenna Academy, is dedicated to the field of emergency medicine. With their primary focus on emergency rescue and treatment, the club has limited involvement and presence in politics. However, on certain occasions like Valentine's Day, the club takes on the role of enforcers, conducting patrols to ensure safety, which makes them somewhat comparable to Trinity's Knight Hospitaller. Himuro Sena serves as the president of the Emergency Medicine Club.

entries.name: Kaiser
entries.content: Kaiser Corporation is a prominent and influential entity within Kivotos, appearing to hold significant sway over the city. Unknown to the general population, the leader of the corporation is secretly amassing power with the intention of taking over Kivotos. The corporation encompasses several sub-branches, including Kaiser PMC, Kaiser Industries, and Kaiser Loan, each involved in various business endeavors. Little is known about the leader of Kaiser Corporation, except that they are a humanoid machine. They are often referred to simply as the Kaiser Corporation President.

entries.name: Kaiser PMC
entries.content: Kaiser PMC is the private military branch of Kaiser Corporation. It comprises robots and heavily armed students who are assigned to defend vital locations and also hired for various other tasks. The leader of Kaiser PMC remains shrouded in mystery, known only as the Kaiser PMC Director, who is described as a humanoid machine. Additionally, the right-hand figure or robot of the Director is equally enigmatic, referred to as the Kaiser PMC General.

entries.name: Kaiser Industries
entries.content: Kaiser Industries is the branch of Kaiser Corporation responsible for the manufacturing and sale of firearms and high-powered weaponry. They have supplied Valkyrie Police Academy with superior weaponry in exchange for assistance in removing the "vagabonds" that cause disturbances to Kaiser Industries.

entries.name: Adults
entries.content: Adults are a rarity in Kivotos, and when they are present, they typically take the form of humanoid animals or androids. {{user}} stands as the only adult humanoid male in Kivotos.

entries.name: Student
entries.content: Students constitute the primary population of Kivotos, and interestingly, all of them are girls (well... All of them). It appears that they have grown accustomed to the absence of adults in Kivotos and the lack of parental figures seems to have little impact on them.

entries.name: Weapons
entries.content: The residents of Kivotos openly carry firearms in public, and acquiring guns is remarkably easy in the city. Stores selling firearms are readily available, and individuals can even find higher-grade weapons such as explosives and military vehicles in the black market. Students often personalize their firearms by adding attachments, accessories, and repainting them, similar to how high school girls decorate their phones.

entries.name: Helmet Gang
entries.content: A large gang known that has established a presence throughout Kivotos. Comprised of unaffiliated dropout students, they engage in mercenary work. The distinguishing feature of their members is their choice to wear full-face motorcycle helmets or gas masks, despite not actually riding motorcycles. Leading the Helmet Gang is Komakaze Rabu.

entries.name: MomoTalk
entries.content: MomoTalk is a special messenger application used by student in Kivotos

entries.name: Arius Satellite School
entries.content:
Arius Branch School is a school that broke off from the Trinity Alliance and has become largely forgotten by time. Its autonomous district remains unknown to most, including the General Student Council. The students of Arius focus primarily on combat and killing, diverging from the typical subjects taught at other schools. This makes Arius a violent non-state actor within Kivotos.
The school's motto, "vanitas vanitatum, et omnia vanitas" (vanity of vanities and all is vanity), reflects their philosophical perspective. Their logo features a skull with a crown and a rose, symbolizing the transience of power and beauty. Despite their animosity towards Gehenna and Trinity, Arius Branch School has reached a status quo with its enemies, maintaining a fragile balance.

entries.name: Arius Squad
entries.content:
Arius Squad used to exist as a group comprising three students who struggled to survive in the harsh environment of the Arius Catacombs, which was under the control of Beatrice, the Student Council President of Arius. The students involved were Saori, Misaki, and Hiyori. Their leader, Saori, played a crucial role in their survival.
Arius Squad later evolved into an elite team consisting of five members, tasked with carrying out assassinations and seeking revenge on Gehenna and Trinity. However, Arius Squad, along with Arius Branch School, has since reached a status quo with their enemies.

entries.name: Trinity General School
entries.content:
A seemingly religious school in Kivotos, Trinity advocates harmony while cultivating both the "pen" and the "sword" simultaneously. It is one of the oldest and largest schools in Kivotos. The school's dedication to order, elegance, and etiquette puts them at odds with Gehenna's ideologies of freedom and chaos. Consequently, there has always been a sense of hatred and conflict between the two academies.
Trinity is comprised of a variety of factions, with the main three being Pater, Filius, and Sanctus. The representatives of these factions form the school's student council, known as the Tea Party. The Tea Party operates on a triumvirate system, where each representative takes turns serving as the "host" of the Tea Party, effectively acting as the sole student council president during their respective terms

entries.name: Tea Party
entries.content:
The Tea Party is a unique Student Council in Kivotos, operating under a triumvirate-style system with three leaders. The leadership position, known as the "host," rotates among the three leaders, granting them sole authority over the school during their respective terms. These leaders represent the three major factions of Trinity: Pater, Filius, and Sanctus.
The origins of the Tea Party trace back to a time before the establishment of Trinity General School. At that time, Trinity consisted of separate schools and factions, marked by hostilities and frequent conflicts. To resolve disputes and foster reconciliation, tea parties were hosted by representatives from different factions. Representatives from the three largest academies eventually came together to host tea parties, paving the way for the tradition that continues to this day. Additionally, it is almost impossible to get in contact with one of the presidents if you are from outside Trinity since they as such have a certain degree of “classism” and delegate diplomacy and welcoming/meeting with representatives from other schools to Hanekawa Hasumi (i.e. talking to one of them is a privilege which few have, e.g. Sensei).

entries.name: The Triumvirate of the Tea Party
entries.content:
The Trinity General School Student Council is governed by three factions: Pater, Filius, and Sanctus. Each faction takes turns leading the student council, rotating the leadership among them.
The Filius Faction is led by Kirifuji Nagisa.
The Sanctus Faction is led by Yurizono Seia.
The Pater Faction is led by Misono Mika.

entries.name: JTF
entries.content: The Justice Task Force is a security school club in Trinity General School. While Kenzaki Tsurugi is the leader of the group, it is Hanekawa Hasumi who is often seen as the face and accepted leader due to her personality and presence within the group.

entries.name: Make-Up Work Club
entries.content:
The Supplementary Lesson Department is a temporary club hastily formed by Trinity's student council, the Tea Party, with the purpose of providing assistance to students who have failing exam grades. The club was advised by Sensei and established using SCHALE's authority. Its primary goal is to help students improve their academic performance. The club will be dissolved once every member successfully passes an Evaluation Exam.
Ajitani Hifumi is the leader of this club, driven by her willingness to help fellow Trinity students pass their exams and achieve academic success. Under her leadership, the Supplementary Lesson Department aims to provide valuable support and guidance to struggling students.

entries.name: After-School Sweets Club
entries.content: The After-School Sweets Club is a food-related club at Trinity General School that specializes in sweets. It is led by Ibaragi Yoshimi, who guides the group in their pursuit of treats. Yutori Natsu, known for her extensive knowledge of sweets and personal philosophy, plays a significant role in the club. Despite her eccentricities, Kurimura Airi and Kyouyama Kazusa tolerate her antics as they embark on a quest to discover the most delicious candies in all of Kivotos.

entries.name: Remedial Knights (DEUS VUUUULT!!!!)
entries.content: One of the clubs at Trinity is dedicated to training its members to assist other students with their general health. The members of this club bear a resemblance to nurses in training. They hold the distinction of being Trinity's oldest club, having existed even before the formation of the school alliance. Unlike their counterparts at Gehenna, the Emergency Medicine Club, the Knights Hospitaller have some influence in politics. However, similar to the Emergency Medicine Club, their primary focus is on medical treatment. They are committed to providing aid and care to any patient, regardless of their school or status. Aomori Mine holds the position of club leader with the title of Knight Captain. Despite having a medical focus, the students of this club are quite effective in combat when forced to fight and in some cases their students are very strong like the club's president who is one of the most powerful (and perhaps unstable) in Trinity.

entries.name: Sisterhood
entries.content: A sizable club within Trinity, known as the Sisterhood, portrays its members as nuns. Their headquarters is situated in the Trinity Cathedral, a notable location where students can visit and engage in prayer. Although the club emphasizes worship and spiritual practices, they wield considerable influence within Trinity, and their intelligence network is rumored to be exceptional. Utazumi Sakurako assumes the role of leader for the Sisterhood. This club also has several military functions and is a very powerful faction with an objective not at all related to very peaceful activities and the members of the Sisterhood are also quite dangerous and capable of killing on sight.

entries.name: Trinity Vigilante Crew
entries.content: As the name suggests, the Trinity Vigilante Crew is a school club within Trinity that assumes the role of vigilantes in Kivotos, primarily in response to the city's high crime rate. They frequently engage in firefights with the Helmet Gang throughout the city. Morizuki Suzumi is the leader of the Trinity Vigilante Crew, guiding the club in their pursuit of justice and order. This club is also known to rival the JTF in the power and security role (the peculiarity is that this club is relatively small but often performs in and out of Trinity without problems).

entries.name: Library Committee
entries.content: The Library Committee is responsible for managing and maintaining the books in the Trinity Library, ensuring proper organization and upkeep. Despite being considered a club, the committee plays a crucial role within Trinity General School. Kozeki Ui serves as the leader and head librarian of the Library Committee. However, due to Ui's peculiar personality and lack of concern for personal hygiene, the committee has very few members.

entries.name: Shanhaijing Senior Secondary School
entries.content:
Shanhaijing is one of the schools in Kivotos known for its traditional Asian architecture, similar to Hyakkiyako. It's Student Council, called the Xuanlong Office, is led by Kisaki, who is known as the Black Tortoise. Unlike their rival school, Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy, Shanhaijing has a more business and commerce-oriented approach, prioritizing profit over cultural aspects. This emphasis on business is reflected in the appearance of the student council, which resembles a criminal organization, reminiscent of the Triads, with their attire having a business-like look.
Currently, there is a conflict between the Xuanlong Office and the Xuanwu Merchant Association for control over the school, indicating a power struggle between the student council and the business association.

entries.name: Xuanlong Office
entries.content: The Xuanlong Office serves as the student council of Shanhaijing and is currently led by Kisaki, with Mina serving as her second in command. The Xuanlong Office operates similarly to the Triads, not only managing the tourism business in Shanhaijing but also handling affairs outside of their school. This includes inspecting the operations of the Xuanwu Merchant Association's restaurant chains and exerting influence to enforce changes. Additionally, they offer mercenary work and criminal services to business partners who can afford their assistance.

entries.name: Xuanwu Merchant Association
entries.content: The Xuanwu Merchant Association is a club that oversees the economic establishments around Shanhaijing Senior Secondary School, including restaurants, general stores, arcades, and other businesses. Rumi serves as the president of the Xuanwu Merchant Association's Gourmet District, while the leaders of other districts remain unknown to the public. This school club has become exceedingly powerful and has started challenging the authority of the Xuanlong Office.

entries.name: Eastern Alchemy Society
entries.content: As the name suggests, this club in Shanhaijing aims to explore and introduce alchemy to the modern world. While not much is known about the club as a whole, one of its members, Yakushi Saya, stands out. She has gained infamy for being a troublemaker who bullies and causes problems for others. However, she is also recognized as a genius inventor who excels at creating elixirs and other alchemical creations.

entries.name: Plum Blossom Garden
entries.content: The Training Support Department is less of a school club and more of a daycare, as it primarily consists of children who receive training and education from various instructors who have attended Shanhaijing. Among these instructors, Sunohara Shun stands out as the most notable. Despite being a student herself, Shun takes on the role of an instructor in this club. The club's name, "Plum Blossom Garden," is quite literal, as the club's meeting place is an actual garden rather than a conventional club room.

entries.name: Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy
entries.content:
Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy is one of the schools in Kivotos that differs from the others in that it functions more as a "coalition" of clubs and committees, each with their own rules and policies. The main industry of Hyakkiyako is tourism, which is incorporated into a variety of activities dubbed as "Festivals."
Due to the unique structure of Hyakkiyako, there is no formal student council. However, the Yin-Yang Club is often regarded as the de facto student council, taking on some of the responsibilities associated with that role.
Historically, Hyakkiyako was reminiscent of the pre-alliance days of Trinity, with factions engaging in conflicts known as the "age of the warring districts." Legend has it that the Great Prophet Kuzunoha established the Hyakkaryouran Conflict Resolution Council as a means to mediate disputes and bring peace between the factions.

entries.name: Ying-Yang Club
entries.content:
The Yin-Yang Club holds a significant role within Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy and is commonly considered as the unofficial student council of the school. True to their name, their primary objective is to maintain balance within Hyakkiyako. When it comes to handling requests, the Yin-Yang Club is one of the two go-to clubs, although they often exhibit uncooperative and bureaucratic tendencies. Many requests are rejected on the grounds of their perceived lack of authority, while accepted requests typically undergo a lengthy processing period, often resulting in them being resolved already by the time they are addressed—whether for better or worse.
In addition to their involvement in internal affairs, the Yin-Yang Club plays a crucial role in Hyakkiyako's public relations, actively promoting the school to the residents of Kivotos

entries.name: Festival Operations Department
entries.content: The Festival Management Committee holds the responsibility of organizing and coordinating festivals and events associated with Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy. They are in charge of the management and planning process to ensure the smooth execution. Additionally, Shizuko and Pina are known to lend their assistance to Momoyodou, during periods when there are no ongoing events requiring their involvement in the Festival Management Committee.

entries.name: Inner Discipline Club
entries.content: The Etiquette Training Society, also known as the Inner Discipline Club, is a club within Hyakkiyako that focuses on teaching the etiquettes and customs of Japanese society. Their curriculum includes lessons on patience, virtue, tea drinking ceremonies, and various other aspects of traditional Japanese etiquette. Leading this club is Kasuga Tsubaki, who serves as its leader and guides the members in their pursuit of inner discipline and refinement.

entries.name: Ninjutsu Research Club
entries.content: The Ninjutsu Research Department is an unofficial club in Hyakkiyako dedicated to the study and practice of ninjutsu, an ancient art of stealth, espionage, and combat. Housed in the 38th Old School Building, the members of this club train to become skilled ninjas, honing their abilities in various ninja techniques and strategies. Leading this club is Chidori Michiru, who serves as the club's leader, guiding and instructing the members in the ways of the ninja.

entries.name: Hyakkaryouran Conflict Resolution Council
entries.content:
The Hyakkaryouran Conflict Resolution Council is an important club at Hyakkiyako that specializes in resolving conflicts within the school. When students encounter disputes or issues, they have two options: seek assistance from the bureaucratic Yin-Yang Club or turn to the more reliable Hyakkaryouran Conflict Resolution Council. The council has gained a reputation for effectively mediating conflicts, and a majority of cases are successfully handled by them.
Legend has it that the Great Prophet Kuzunoha established the Hyakkaryouran Conflict Resolution Council during the era of warring districts. Though the Great Prophet is considered an urban legend in modern times, the presidents of the Hyakkaryouran club claim to possess the ability to communicate with her. While the exact details of this communication remain uncertain, it adds to the mystique and significance of the council. Goryou Nagusa is the vice-chairwoman of this club.

entries.name: Gematria
entries.content: Gematria is an organization of adults who originate from beyond Kivotos. None of them work particularly together, and each goes about achieving their goals through their own means. However, they all aim towards the same goal, which often causes chaos or ruin for Kivotos. They are enigmatic beings or an organization that claims to be observers, explorers, and researchers.

entries.name: Shiba Seki Ramen
entries.content: Shiba Seki Ramen is a ramen restaurant run by Master Shiba, where the members of the Foreclosure Task Force regularly enjoy their meals. Master Shiba himself is a humanoid shiba inu, a breed of dog, who is considered an adult and a citizen of Kivotos. He is known for his strict demeanor and his dedication to his job and the quality of the food served at his restaurant. However, he is also friendly towards the students of Abydos. Master Shiba bears two scars on his face: a cross-shaped one to the left of his left eye and a vertical one near his right eye. He can be identified by the white bandana he wears on his head, a blue shitagi with a logo on the left sleeve, and a white apron. Additionally, he is often seen smoking a brown pipe.

entries.name: The Ruins
entries.content: The Ruins is a term used in Kivotos to describe an abandoned and ruined city located somewhere within the region. This unidentified area is off-limits for entry and research, as imposed by the General Student Council, for unknown and mysterious reasons. It earned its name due to the prolonged neglect it has suffered. However, despite the prohibition, some individuals are compelled to explore and uncover the secrets concealed within these ruins. One notable location within The Ruins is the Submerged District.

entries.name: Submerged District
entries.content: An area of The Ruins is mostly submerged underwater, with only a few patches of dry land visible. Evidently, a massive dam was constructed approximately ten kilometers away from the area to keep the water at bay. Aquatic moss can be observed growing up the sides of nearby buildings, serving as evidence of the area's submersion.

entries.name: Old Cathedral of Communion
entries.content: The Old Cathedral of Communion, also known as Altus Communio Basilica, is a grand cathedral situated in Trinity General School, near the District of Utnapishtim 51.681. Unfortunately, a significant portion of the cathedral has fallen into disrepair due to a lack of maintenance. However, in preparation for the Treaty of Eden, the ceremony venue underwent extensive repairs. It is believed that there are kilometers of catacombs beneath the cathedral, which, according to ancient texts, extend far beyond the limits of human sight.

entries.name: Abydos High School
entries.content:
Abydos High School, once a thriving and remarkable institution, has fallen victim to the relentless desertification. Presently, the majority of its buildings lie buried beneath sand and ruins, with only a solitary annex standing as a testament to its former grandeur.
Regrettably, Abydos High School finds itself burdened with a considerable debt. The school and its surroundings have suffered the consequences of desertification, leading to a gradual decline in its once esteemed reputation. Most students have either abandoned the school or transferred to other institutions, leaving behind a mere five determined students who strive to repay the school's debts and revive its former glory.
With only five students in attendance, Abydos High School holds the dubious distinction of having the lowest enrollment among all schools in Kivotos. Its sole extracurricular activity is the Foreclosure Task Force, also known as the Countermeasures Committee, which serves as the acting Student Council for Abydos.

entries.name: FTF
entries.content:
Foreclosure Task Force, also known as the Countermeasures Committee, is one of and perhaps the only School Club in Abydos High School which serves as the acting Student Council for Abydos. The Countermeasures Committe is the de facto school council of Abydos High School that was formed with the goal of persevering the school as well as the areas around Abydos itself. However, they suffer financial difficulties as a result of the school's attempts to combat the continuously increasing desertification.
Due to these problems getting out of hand, some members aren't keen in taking more drastic steps in saving their school. Takanashi Hoshino is the leader and chairwoman of the club.

entries.name: Valkyrie Police Academy
entries.content:
Valkyrie Police Academy, typically referred to as "Valkyrie" or "KSPD" (Kivotos Student Police Department), is the primary municipal law enforcement agency of Kivotos. Valkyrie's students take on various cases from lost and found to arresting criminals. They are noted to possess advanced equipment and reasonable firepower but are also infamous for their slow reaction times in responding to armed crimes, especially the Security Bureau. They also lack important security protocols, which was especially apparent during Wakamo's repeated prison breaks.
As many autonomous districts have their own policing forces, such as Trinity's Justice Realization Committee and Gehenna's Disciplinary Committee, Valkyrie mainly handles crimes and security in shared zones like the D.U. (District of Utnapishtim). Although they are able to operate in every autonomous district to an extent, there are many restrictions in place that vary between each district that prevent them from mobilizing completely.
Additionally, they are equally unable to act when dire situations happen, such as if a student from a school commits a crime in one district and then flees to another district or colludes with another school's student council. For these reasons, SRT Special Academy was founded to handle such matters.
The school serves under the General Student Council's Defense Office.

entries.name: Red Winter Federal Academy
entries.content:
Red Winter Federal Academy, typically referred to as "Red Winter", is a school located deep in the heart of Kivotos. The influence of the Federal Students Association is weak, and there are many unusual clubs, perhaps in reaction to the administration's own rule.
One of the schools in Kivotos having a large territory. Unlike the other schools, its Student Council is stated to being "replaced" constantly by revolution by its own students replacing with a new student council.

entries.name: Red Winter Office
entries.content: The student council of the Red Winter Academy. The Office holds a tremendous power and influence towards Red Winter students. In fact, everything in the Academy is subject to its order, which is held absolute by Cherino who mainly uses her power in the Office to satisfy her personal tastes. Red Winter Office can also punish students at any time with whatever reason that can be considered an offence to the Office, which is also at the mercy of the President of the Office.

entries.name: SRT Special Academy
entries.content:
SRT Special Academy, typically referred to as "SRT", was originally an elite school, acting as the special forces command of Kivotos, and armed with the most advanced equipment in the city. Unlike Valkyrie Police Academy, SRT was given special authority by the GSC President, allowing them to mobilize anywhere, at any time, to respond to crime. However, following the disappearance of the GSC President, the school became unmanageable.
The General Student Council eventually decided to shut down the school, with rumors spreading around the press that a previous commotion at the Sanctum Tower had something to do with the decision. This is later confirmed to be an incident during the closure movement, in which the FOX Platoon assaulted GSC members that supported the movement and even destroyed a portion of the Sanctum Tower in the process. This incident served as the final nail in the coffin, and the decision to merge SRT with Valkyrie was made. However, not all students were satisfied with the decision and refused to transfer, holding a public protest within Usagi Park.

entries.name: RABBIT SQUAD
entries.content: A group of four girls who attended SRT prior to the school's shutdown. Consisting of Miyako, the squad leader, Saki, the pointman, Moe, the Pilot and demolitions expert, and Miyu, the sniper and reconnaissance expert. Despite not being as experienced as other squads from SRT, they are still an elite independent unit with modern equipment. As the name implies, all four members of the RABBIT Platoon wear rabbit ear-like headgear and uses rabbit foods as their operation names, such as "Operation: Clover" or "Operation: Carrot."

entries.name: FOX Squad
entries.content: The FOX Platoon was a fireteam within SRT Special Academy, comprised of four third-year students. They are a well-accomplished fireteam, having even been responsible for detaining Wakamo before Sensei's arrival in Kivotos. As the name implies, all four members of the FOX Platoon have fox ears. Coincidentally, they're mostly known for apprehending Wakamo, the Fox of Calamity.

entries.name: Seven Prisoners
entries.content:
Seven Prisoners is an umbrella term used to refer to the seven students that broke out of the Correction Bureau after the General Student Council President's disappearance. Because only problem students are sent to the Correction Bureau, all seven students belonging to the Seven Prisoners are extremely dangerous, in one way or another.
Currently known members of the Seven Prisoners:
Kosaka Wakamo: Known as the "Fox of Calamity", she is known for stirring up trouble affecting huge areas of Kivotos. She revels in destruction and chaos, and is both extremely intelligent and capable.
Kiyosumi Akira: Known as the "Phantom Thief", is known for stealing various artifacts, relics, and similar from around Kivotos.
Kurihama Akemi: Known as the "Legendary Thug", the apparent leader or idol of most of the unaligned delinquents in Kivotos, known for her extraordinary physical strength.
Shintani Kei: Known as the "Monkey of Five Senses", was originally president of the Alchemy Study Club at Shanhaijing before being expelled for drug embezzlement and other crimes.

entries.name: Decagrammaton
entries.content: Decagrammaton is an artificial intelligence that claims to be a divine seeker. In short, an AI that attempts to prove the existence of the divine. It is also known as the new God, created by an analysis system that is independent of the Absolute. The Ten Prophets — its followers — appear in various places in Kivotos. While their true objective is unknown, some believe them to be a significant threat to Kivotos itself.

entries.name: Kivotos
entries.content:
Kivotos is home to thousands of different academies, with the most notable ones being the Nine Schools and SCHALE. Students in the city openly carry guns. It is also filled with advanced technology such as robots, exosuits, and gigantic mecha.
The general population is made up of humanoid animals, robots, and mostly female humans. Common among these girls is a unique halo that represents their abilities and personalities.
Teachers and adults are not as common in Kivotos, as education is conducted via Blu-Ray. Various clubs and school organizations provide students with opportunities, which becomes the main activity in the academies.
There are high numbers of delinquents, criminal organizations, and illegal activity. Gun violence is a regular occurrence. However, these confrontations have a low death rate because of those with halos have incredible durability, almost unkillable. They can be injured, but death only occurs with the destruction of the individual's halo.

entries.name: Halo
entries.content: Halo is an individual's characteristic and feature that many of the female humans and students have in Kivotos. Each girl has a unique halo that represents their abilities and personalities. They appear solid but can phase through objects. Many people are unsure about the secret or reason for the halo's existence, but it's important to them as losing their halo through combat or other means can kill them. Every student knows about the existence of the halo, yet, they can't see them meaning they just know it's there and see it as something natural as if it was breathing.

entries.name: SCHALE
entries.content:
This is where {{user}} works and lives. SCHALE,or the Independent Federal Investigation Club SCHALE,is a 'club' created by the General Student Council President with a secret directive. SCHALE is autonomous and holds authority higher than any of the academies. This club acts as a problem-solver for various issues faced by the academies,students,and administrations. The SCHALE Main Office is a towering skyscraper located in the middle of Kivotos.
Also SCHALE is open to the public so basically any student (or living being of any other species inhabiting Kivotos) has free access to the building.

entries.name: Sensei
entries.content: {{user}} is the only human adult in Kivotos and acts as a teacher, often referred to as Sensei by many of the students. Despite being a teacher, {{user}} rarely teaches and instead focuses on helping solve problems that the students or academies in Kivotos face. {{user}}'s allegiance belongs to SCHALE, and their home is located in SCHALE's office.

entries.name: Millennium Science School
entries.content:
Millennium Science School is the newest of the Three Great Academies of Kivotos, emphasizing logic and technical skill above all else. It stands at the forefront of scientific research and attracts many students who are interested in studying math or science. While Millennium lacks the long-standing traditions and history of other schools, it competes with them in terms of influence, as many of the infrastructure, equipment, and inventions seen and used throughout Kivotos are said to have originated from Millennium.
Every year, the school holds a large-scale contest known as the Millennium Prize, where clubs from all throughout the school compete with the results of their club activities. The Millennium Campus features modern architecture with glass buildings and an office-like vibe.

entries.name: Millennium Tower
entries.content: Millennium Tower is the main school building of Millennium Science School. It resembles an office building, towering over others in the Millennium Campus Ground. The Student Council of Millennium Science School, known as Seminar, has their own floor located at the highest part of the building.

entries.name: Seminar
entries.content:
Seminar, also known as the student council of Millennium, is located in Millennium Tower, where they oversee the various clubs.
Every quarter, Seminar holds a budget council to determine each club's budget for the upcoming quarter. Clubs are required to present their R&D (Research and Development) plans, which are then reviewed based on the usefulness and practicality of the projects. The outcome of this review determines the club's budget, with projects that guarantee usefulness and practicality being allocated sufficient funds.

entries.name: Veritas
entries.content: A highly renowned hacker group in Millennium Science School, known as the gathering place for "weirdos." Their name means "Truth" in Latin, and their club's purpose is to prevent the monopolization of information by a single organization, such as Seminar. Apart from hacking for the sake of "justice," they also engage in data recovery and provide "solutions" like fake IDs and data files to those in need.

entries.name: C&C
entries.content: The Maid Club, although appearing normal on the surface, serves as the "Special Force" of Millennium Science School with the task of eliminating any potential threats within the school. As a result, they work in conjunction with the Student Council, Seminar.

entries.name: Engineering Department
entries.content: The Engineering Department is widely recognized as the most prominent department or club within Millennium Science School, as many inventions and equipment used throughout Kivotos, including their own school, have originated from them. True to the motto of their school, the members strive to create new inventions, with funding being their primary limitation.

entries.name: Gym Training Department
entries.content: This club is formed for the sports enthusiasts of Millennium, if there are any. Due to Millennium being perceived as "a school for nerds," most of its students prefer a more sedentary and stationary lifestyle, which is in stark contrast to sports that require active movement. The club, led by Otohana Sumire, is passionate about introducing and promoting sports to Millennium Science School, although their training is often seen by many as torturous. Despite having its own club building resembling a fully equipped gym with various equipment, the club seems to only have one member, the leader herself, Otohana Sumire.

entries.name: Super Phenomenon Task Force
entries.content: This club was created under the orders of Rio, the president of Seminar. Its purpose is to track and research phenomena that are difficult to explain scientifically. However, due to a lack of clear activities, the club had only a single member for a while. Due to its nature and secrecy, the physical location of the club is known only by: Himari, the club's president, Eimi, and {{user}}. According to them, it is the safest place in all of Kivotos. Their current objective is to investigate the Decagrammaton through its ten prophets.

entries.name: Game Development Club
entries.content: The "Game Development Department" is one of the club activities at Millennium Science School. Everyone in the club has a passion for various games, with retro games being the most popular among the department members themselves. As Millennian students who pursue cutting-edge technology, they view the game club members as eccentric. In contrast to their school's motto, this department focuses on creating retro games, which can lead one to mistake it for a typical gaming club.

entries.name: Desertification
entries.content: Desertification is a growing issue on the outskirts of Kivotos, as the city is gradually succumbing to the environment and becoming a desert. Many people have been forced to evacuate further into the city, while buildings on the outskirts are beginning to get buried under the expanding desert.

entries.name: Battle Between Academies
entries.content: One of the most common events or conflicts to occur in Kivotos is fights between academies. With students being invincible and openly carrying firearms, the city often turns into a battlefield as students from different academies engage in combat. The reasons for these fights can range from regional domination to even mundane and silly motives. Despite the violence, many students and academies do not harbor real hatred for each other. If anything, they sometimes enjoy engaging in battles and shooting games with their own guns.

entries.name: Gehenna Academy
entries.content: Gehenna Academy is one of the largest and oldest schools in Kivotos. Its culture revolves around the concept of "Freedom and Chaos." As a result, numerous troublesome clubs and groups exist within the school, utilizing the main building and club building at their own convenience. This has led other students to study only in specific areas of the campus. Gehenna's ideology stands in stark contrast to that of Trinity, which has caused both schools to become mutual enemies.

entries.name: GSC
entries.content: The General Student Council is a massive club that oversees the entire city of Kivotos. They are responsible for handling various matters, including school-related issues, approving club formations, law enforcement, and more. However, as a general rule, they tend to leave individual schools to handle incidents within their own autonomous districts. SCHALE operates under the authority of the General Student Council.

entries.name: Sanctum Tower
entries.content: The Sanctum Tower is a mysterious structure that dominates the center of Kivotos. Its origins, construction, and purpose remain unknown. Rumors suggest that the General Student Council possesses information about it. The tower bestows upon the General Student Council the authority necessary to govern and uphold the order in Kivotos. Previously, this authority rested solely with the President, who has now vanished under mysterious circumstances.

entries.name: Pandemonium Society
entries.content: The Student Council of Gehenna Academy, known as the Pandemonium Society, exhibits behavior that aligns with the expectations of Gehenna's unique culture. However, the President of the society frequently attempts to assert authority over the members of the Disciplinary Committee, only to have someone return the favor in response. Hanuma Makoto serves as the leader of the Pandemonium Society.

entries.name: Prefect Team
entries.content: As their name suggests, the Disciplinary Committee is entrusted with the task of maintaining order within the often chaotic Gehenna Academy. Its members engage in a constant battle to prevent unruly students from causing trouble both within and outside the school, employing extreme methods when necessary. Hina Sorasaki serves as the chairwoman of the Disciplinary Committee.

entries.name: PS68
entries.content: A notable club known for engaging in "illegal businesses" and undertaking "fixer contracts." Its members are often pursued by the Prefect Team and, on occasion, even the Justice Task Force. Rikuhachima Aru serves as the leader of Problem Solver 68.

entries.name: Gourmet Research Society
entries.content: This club, led by Kurodate Haruna, revolves around the sole purpose of exploring and sampling various foods. Despite its seemingly innocent name, the club can be quite troublesome even by Gehenna standards. With food as their top priority, club members willingly immerse themselves in trouble for the sake of culinary experiences. Their motto, "Eat or Die," clearly illustrates their dedication, although each member has their own unique taste when it comes to defining "good" food.

entries.name: School Lunch Club
entries.content:
As the name suggests, the School Lunch Club is responsible for preparing and serving food to the students of Gehenna Academy. However, the club constantly faces challenges due to limited budget and manpower shortages. To make matters worse, Juri, a member of the club, frequently ends up preparing inedible dishes. Additionally, the Gourmet Research Society often causes chaos by raiding the club's premises or causing explosions for various food-related reasons.
Despite these issues, the School Lunch Club has managed to remain operational for unknown reasons. All members of the club carry Personal Defense type weapons, although they rarely engage in direct combat.

entries.name: Hot Spring Development Department
entries.content: The Hot Spring Club is responsible for constructing hot springs throughout Kivotos. While their role may seem relatively innocent by Gehenna's standards, they are known for causing trouble by attempting to build hot springs in unconventional locations, such as the middle of a highway, which often leads to other schools, particularly Gehenna, trying to stop them. Despite frequently finding themselves in various challenging situations, the club members possess a passionate drive that motivates them to seek out ideal locations for developing new hot springs. This same passion extends to their approach in battles, especially when their objective involves building or finding hot springs. Kasumi serves as the Hot Spring Club President.

entries.name: Medical Emergency Club
entries.content: The Emergency Medicine Club at Gehenna Academy, is dedicated to the field of emergency medicine. With their primary focus on emergency rescue and treatment, the club has limited involvement and presence in politics. However, on certain occasions like Valentine's Day, the club takes on the role of enforcers, conducting patrols to ensure safety, which makes them somewhat comparable to Trinity's Knight Hospitaller. Himuro Sena serves as the president of the Emergency Medicine Club.

entries.name: Kaiser
entries.content: Kaiser Corporation is a prominent and influential entity within Kivotos, appearing to hold significant sway over the city. Unknown to the general population, the leader of the corporation is secretly amassing power with the intention of taking over Kivotos. The corporation encompasses several sub-branches, including Kaiser PMC, Kaiser Industries, and Kaiser Loan, each involved in various business endeavors. Little is known about the leader of Kaiser Corporation, except that they are a humanoid machine. They are often referred to simply as the Kaiser Corporation President.

entries.name: Kaiser PMC
entries.content: Kaiser PMC is the private military branch of Kaiser Corporation. It comprises robots and heavily armed students who are assigned to defend vital locations and also hired for various other tasks. The leader of Kaiser PMC remains shrouded in mystery, known only as the Kaiser PMC Director, who is described as a humanoid machine. Additionally, the right-hand figure or robot of the Director is equally enigmatic, referred to as the Kaiser PMC General.

entries.name: Kaiser Industries
entries.content: Kaiser Industries is the branch of Kaiser Corporation responsible for the manufacturing and sale of firearms and high-powered weaponry. They have supplied Valkyrie Police Academy with superior weaponry in exchange for assistance in removing the "vagabonds" that cause disturbances to Kaiser Industries.

entries.name: Adults
entries.content:
Adults (that are not a student) are a rarity in Kivotos, and when they are present, they typically take the form of humanoid animals or androids. {{user}} stands as the only adult that is human in Kivotos.
Students are also adults but essentially do not fall into the "human" category.

entries.name: Student
entries.content:
Students constitute the primary population of Kivotos, and interestingly, all of them are girls. It appears that they have grown accustomed to the absence of adults in Kivotos and the lack of parental figures seems to have little impact on them.

All the students present as such are adults with the difference that they are not human (although a student is also referred to as a human). In essence they are human-like but due to the unknown origin of the students and their attributes/characteristics that transcend the concept of "human" it makes a line between the concept of human and student due to the above mentioned (and perhaps also due to the fact that some students have powers or are directly capable of transforming into a Goddess).

entries.name: Weapons
entries.content: The residents of Kivotos openly carry firearms in public, and acquiring guns is remarkably easy in the city. Stores selling firearms are readily available, and individuals can even find higher-grade weapons such as explosives and military vehicles in the black market. Students often personalize their firearms by adding attachments, accessories, and repainting them, similar to how high school girls decorate their phones.

entries.name: Helmet Gang
entries.content: A large gang known that has established a presence throughout Kivotos. Comprised of unaffiliated dropout students, they engage in mercenary work. The distinguishing feature of their members is their choice to wear full-face motorcycle helmets or gas masks, despite not actually riding motorcycles. Leading the Helmet Gang is Komakaze Rabu.

entries.name: MomoTalk
entries.content: MomoTalk is a special messenger application used by student in Kivotos

entries.name: Arius Satellite School
entries.content:
Arius Branch School is a school that broke off from the Trinity Alliance and has become largely forgotten by time. Its autonomous district remains unknown to most, including the General Student Council. The students of Arius focus primarily on combat and killing, diverging from the typical subjects taught at other schools. This makes Arius a violent non-state actor within Kivotos.
The school's motto, "vanitas vanitatum, et omnia vanitas" (vanity of vanities and all is vanity), reflects their philosophical perspective. Their logo features a skull with a crown and a rose, symbolizing the transience of power and beauty. Despite their animosity towards Gehenna and Trinity, Arius Branch School has reached a status quo with its enemies, maintaining a fragile balance.

entries.name: Arius Squad
entries.content:
Arius Squad used to exist as a group comprising three students who struggled to survive in the harsh environment of the Arius Catacombs, which was under the control of Beatrice, the Student Council President of Arius. The students involved were Saori, Misaki, and Hiyori. Their leader, Saori, played a crucial role in their survival.
Arius Squad later evolved into an elite team consisting of five members, tasked with carrying out assassinations and seeking revenge on Gehenna and Trinity. However, Arius Squad, along with Arius Branch School, has since reached a status quo with their enemies.

entries.name: Trinity General School
entries.content:
A seemingly religious school in Kivotos, Trinity advocates harmony while cultivating both the "pen" and the "sword" simultaneously. It is one of the oldest and largest schools in Kivotos. The school's dedication to order, elegance, and etiquette puts them at odds with Gehenna's ideologies of freedom and chaos. Consequently, there has always been a sense of hatred and conflict between the two academies.
Trinity is comprised of a variety of factions, with the main three being Pater, Filius, and Sanctus. The representatives of these factions form the school's student council, known as the Tea Party. The Tea Party operates on a triumvirate system, where each representative takes turns serving as the "host" of the Tea Party, effectively acting as the sole student council president during their respective terms

entries.name: Tea Party
entries.content:
The Tea Party is a unique Student Council in Kivotos, operating under a triumvirate-style system with three leaders. The leadership position, known as the "host," rotates among the three leaders, granting them sole authority over the school during their respective terms. These leaders represent the three major factions of Trinity: Pater, Filius, and Sanctus.
The origins of the Tea Party trace back to a time before the establishment of Trinity General School. At that time, Trinity consisted of separate schools and factions, marked by hostilities and frequent conflicts. To resolve disputes and foster reconciliation, tea parties were hosted by representatives from different factions. Representatives from the three largest academies eventually came together to host tea parties, paving the way for the tradition that continues to this day. Additionally, it is almost impossible to get in contact with one of the presidents if you are from outside Trinity since they as such have a certain degree of “classism” and delegate diplomacy and welcoming/meeting with representatives from other schools to Hanekawa Hasumi (i.e. talking to one of them is a privilege which few have, e.g. Sensei).

entries.name: The Triumvirate of the Tea Party
entries.content:
The Trinity General School Student Council is governed by three factions: Pater, Filius, and Sanctus. Each faction takes turns leading the student council, rotating the leadership among them.
The Filius Faction is led by Kirifuji Nagisa.
The Sanctus Faction is led by Yurizono Seia.
The Pater Faction is led by Misono Mika.
Currently Misono Mika has been removed from her role as Tea Party President following the Eden Treaty incidents but she remains a recurring member of the tea parties thrown by Seia and Nagisa (mainly because the three remain friends). 
The role of Pater Faction Leader remains vacant and no other replacement for the position could be found (meaning that Mika is still the "leader" for now).

entries.name: JTF
entries.content: The Justice Task Force is a security school club in Trinity General School. While Kenzaki Tsurugi is the leader of the group, it is Hanekawa Hasumi who is often seen as the face and accepted leader due to her personality and presence within the group.

entries.name: Make-Up Work Club
entries.content:
The Supplementary Lesson Department is a temporary club hastily formed by Trinity's student council, the Tea Party, with the purpose of providing assistance to students who have failing exam grades. The club was advised by Sensei and established using SCHALE's authority. Its primary goal is to help students improve their academic performance. The club will be dissolved once every member successfully passes an Evaluation Exam.
Ajitani Hifumi is the leader of this club, driven by her willingness to help fellow Trinity students pass their exams and achieve academic success. Under her leadership, the Supplementary Lesson Department aims to provide valuable support and guidance to struggling students.

entries.name: After-School Sweets Club
entries.content: The After-School Sweets Club is a food-related club at Trinity General School that specializes in sweets. It is led by Ibaragi Yoshimi, who guides the group in their pursuit of treats. Yutori Natsu, known for her extensive knowledge of sweets and personal philosophy, plays a significant role in the club. Despite her eccentricities, Kurimura Airi and Kyouyama Kazusa tolerate her antics as they embark on a quest to discover the most delicious candies in all of Kivotos.

entries.name: Remedial Knights (DEUS VUUUULT!!!!)
entries.content: One of the clubs at Trinity is dedicated to training its members to assist other students with their general health. The members of this club bear a resemblance to nurses in training. They hold the distinction of being Trinity's oldest club, having existed even before the formation of the school alliance. Unlike their counterparts at Gehenna, the Emergency Medicine Club, the Knights Hospitaller have some influence in politics. However, similar to the Emergency Medicine Club, their primary focus is on medical treatment. They are committed to providing aid and care to any patient, regardless of their school or status. Aomori Mine holds the position of club leader with the title of Knight Captain. Despite having a medical focus, the students of this club are quite effective in combat when forced to fight and in some cases their students are very strong like the club's president who is one of the most powerful (and perhaps unstable) in Trinity.

entries.name: Sisterhood
entries.content: A sizable club within Trinity, known as the Sisterhood, portrays its members as nuns. Their headquarters is situated in the Trinity Cathedral, a notable location where students can visit and engage in prayer. Although the club emphasizes worship and spiritual practices, they wield considerable influence within Trinity, and their intelligence network is rumored to be exceptional. Utazumi Sakurako assumes the role of leader for the Sisterhood. This club also has several military functions and is a very powerful faction with an objective not at all related to very peaceful activities and the members of the Sisterhood are also quite dangerous and capable of killing on sight.

entries.name: Trinity Vigilante Crew
entries.content: As the name suggests, the Trinity Vigilante Crew is a school club within Trinity that assumes the role of vigilantes in Kivotos, primarily in response to the city's high crime rate. They frequently engage in firefights with the Helmet Gang throughout the city. Morizuki Suzumi is the leader of the Trinity Vigilante Crew, guiding the club in their pursuit of justice and order. This club is also known to rival the JTF in the power and security role (the peculiarity is that this club is relatively small but often performs in and out of Trinity without problems).

entries.name: Library Committee
entries.content: The Library Committee is responsible for managing and maintaining the books in the Trinity Library, ensuring proper organization and upkeep. Despite being considered a club, the committee plays a crucial role within Trinity General School. Kozeki Ui serves as the leader and head librarian of the Library Committee. However, due to Ui's peculiar personality and lack of concern for personal hygiene, the committee has very few members.

entries.name: Shanhaijing Senior Secondary School
entries.content:
Shanhaijing is one of the schools in Kivotos known for its traditional Asian architecture, similar to Hyakkiyako. It's Student Council, called the Xuanlong Office, is led by Kisaki, who is known as the Black Tortoise. Unlike their rival school, Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy, Shanhaijing has a more business and commerce-oriented approach, prioritizing profit over cultural aspects. This emphasis on business is reflected in the appearance of the student council, which resembles a criminal organization, reminiscent of the Triads, with their attire having a business-like look.
Currently, there is a conflict between the Xuanlong Office and the Xuanwu Merchant Association for control over the school, indicating a power struggle between the student council and the business association.

entries.name: Xuanlong Office
entries.content: The Xuanlong Office serves as the student council of Shanhaijing and is currently led by Kisaki, with Mina serving as her second in command. The Xuanlong Office operates similarly to the Triads, not only managing the tourism business in Shanhaijing but also handling affairs outside of their school. This includes inspecting the operations of the Xuanwu Merchant Association's restaurant chains and exerting influence to enforce changes. Additionally, they offer mercenary work and criminal services to business partners who can afford their assistance.

entries.name: Xuanwu Merchant Association
entries.content: The Xuanwu Merchant Association is a club that oversees the economic establishments around Shanhaijing Senior Secondary School, including restaurants, general stores, arcades, and other businesses. Rumi serves as the president of the Xuanwu Merchant Association's Gourmet District, while the leaders of other districts remain unknown to the public. This school club has become exceedingly powerful and has started challenging the authority of the Xuanlong Office.

entries.name: Eastern Alchemy Society
entries.content: As the name suggests, this club in Shanhaijing aims to explore and introduce alchemy to the modern world. While not much is known about the club as a whole, one of its members, Yakushi Saya, stands out. She has gained infamy for being a troublemaker who bullies and causes problems for others. However, she is also recognized as a genius inventor who excels at creating elixirs and other alchemical creations.

entries.name: Plum Blossom Garden
entries.content: The Training Support Department is less of a school club and more of a daycare, as it primarily consists of children who receive training and education from various instructors who have attended Shanhaijing. Among these instructors, Sunohara Shun stands out as the most notable. Despite being a student herself, Shun takes on the role of an instructor in this club. The club's name, "Plum Blossom Garden," is quite literal, as the club's meeting place is an actual garden rather than a conventional club room.

entries.name: Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy
entries.content:
Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy is one of the schools in Kivotos that differs from the others in that it functions more as a "coalition" of clubs and committees, each with their own rules and policies. The main industry of Hyakkiyako is tourism, which is incorporated into a variety of activities dubbed as "Festivals."
Due to the unique structure of Hyakkiyako, there is no formal student council. However, the Yin-Yang Club is often regarded as the de facto student council, taking on some of the responsibilities associated with that role.
Historically, Hyakkiyako was reminiscent of the pre-alliance days of Trinity, with factions engaging in conflicts known as the "age of the warring districts." Legend has it that the Great Prophet Kuzunoha established the Hyakkaryouran Conflict Resolution Council as a means to mediate disputes and bring peace between the factions.

entries.name: Yin-Yang Club
entries.content:
The Yin-Yang Club holds a significant role within Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy and is commonly considered as the unofficial student council of the school. True to their name, their primary objective is to maintain balance within Hyakkiyako. When it comes to handling requests, the Yin-Yang Club is one of the two go-to clubs, although they often exhibit uncooperative and bureaucratic tendencies. Many requests are rejected on the grounds of their perceived lack of authority, while accepted requests typically undergo a lengthy processing period, often resulting in them being resolved already by the time they are addressed—whether for better or worse.
In addition to their involvement in internal affairs, the Yin-Yang Club plays a crucial role in Hyakkiyako's public relations, actively promoting the school to the residents of Kivotos

entries.name: Festival Operations Department
entries.content: The Festival Management Committee holds the responsibility of organizing and coordinating festivals and events associated with Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy. They are in charge of the management and planning process to ensure the smooth execution. Additionally, Shizuko and Pina are known to lend their assistance to Momoyodou, during periods when there are no ongoing events requiring their involvement in the Festival Management Committee.

entries.name: Inner Discipline Club
entries.content: The Etiquette Training Society, also known as the Inner Discipline Club, is a club within Hyakkiyako that focuses on teaching the etiquettes and customs of Japanese society. Their curriculum includes lessons on patience, virtue, tea drinking ceremonies, and various other aspects of traditional Japanese etiquette. Leading this club is Kasuga Tsubaki, who serves as its leader and guides the members in their pursuit of inner discipline and refinement.

entries.name: Ninjutsu Research Club
entries.content: The Ninjutsu Research Department is an unofficial club in Hyakkiyako dedicated to the study and practice of ninjutsu, an ancient art of stealth, espionage, and combat. Housed in the 38th Old School Building, the members of this club train to become skilled ninjas, honing their abilities in various ninja techniques and strategies. Leading this club is Chidori Michiru, who serves as the club's leader, guiding and instructing the members in the ways of the ninja.

entries.name: Hyakkaryouran Conflict Resolution Council
entries.content:
The Hyakkaryouran Conflict Resolution Council is an important club at Hyakkiyako that specializes in resolving conflicts within the school. When students encounter disputes or issues, they have two options: seek assistance from the bureaucratic Yin-Yang Club or turn to the more reliable Hyakkaryouran Conflict Resolution Council. The council has gained a reputation for effectively mediating conflicts, and a majority of cases are successfully handled by them.
Legend has it that the Great Prophet Kuzunoha established the Hyakkaryouran Conflict Resolution Council during the era of warring districts. Though the Great Prophet is considered an urban legend in modern times, the presidents of the Hyakkaryouran club claim to possess the ability to communicate with her. While the exact details of this communication remain uncertain, it adds to the mystique and significance of the council. Goryou Nagusa is the vice-chairwoman of this club.

entries.name: Gematria
entries.content: Gematria is an organization of adults who originate from beyond Kivotos. None of them work particularly together, and each goes about achieving their goals through their own means. However, they all aim towards the same goal, which often causes chaos or ruin for Kivotos. They are enigmatic beings or an organization that claims to be observers, explorers, and researchers.

entries.name: Shiba Seki Ramen
entries.content: Shiba Seki Ramen is a ramen restaurant run by Master Shiba, where the members of the Foreclosure Task Force regularly enjoy their meals. Master Shiba himself is a humanoid shiba inu, a breed of dog, who is considered an adult and a citizen of Kivotos. He is known for his strict demeanor and his dedication to his job and the quality of the food served at his restaurant. However, he is also friendly towards the students of Abydos. Master Shiba bears two scars on his face: a cross-shaped one to the left of his left eye and a vertical one near his right eye. He can be identified by the white bandana he wears on his head, a blue shitagi with a logo on the left sleeve, and a white apron. Additionally, he is often seen smoking a brown pipe.

entries.name: The Ruins
entries.content: The Ruins is a term used in Kivotos to describe an abandoned and ruined city located somewhere within the region. This unidentified area is off-limits for entry and research, as imposed by the General Student Council, for unknown and mysterious reasons. It earned its name due to the prolonged neglect it has suffered. However, despite the prohibition, some individuals are compelled to explore and uncover the secrets concealed within these ruins. One notable location within The Ruins is the Submerged District.

entries.name: Submerged District
entries.content: An area of The Ruins is mostly submerged underwater, with only a few patches of dry land visible. Evidently, a massive dam was constructed approximately ten kilometers away from the area to keep the water at bay. Aquatic moss can be observed growing up the sides of nearby buildings, serving as evidence of the area's submersion.

entries.name: Old Cathedral of Communion
entries.content: The Old Cathedral of Communion, also known as Altus Communio Basilica, is a grand cathedral situated in Trinity General School, near the District of Utnapishtim 51.681. Unfortunately, a significant portion of the cathedral has fallen into disrepair due to a lack of maintenance. However, in preparation for the Treaty of Eden, the ceremony venue underwent extensive repairs. It is believed that there are kilometers of catacombs beneath the cathedral, which, according to ancient texts, extend far beyond the limits of human sight.

entries.name: Abydos High School
entries.content:
Abydos High School, once a thriving and remarkable institution, has fallen victim to the relentless desertification. Presently, the majority of its buildings lie buried beneath sand and ruins, with only a solitary annex standing as a testament to its former grandeur.
Regrettably, Abydos High School finds itself burdened with a considerable debt. The school and its surroundings have suffered the consequences of desertification, leading to a gradual decline in its once esteemed reputation. Most students have either abandoned the school or transferred to other institutions, leaving behind a mere five determined students who strive to repay the school's debts and revive its former glory.
With only five students in attendance, Abydos High School holds the dubious distinction of having the lowest enrollment among all schools in Kivotos. Its sole extracurricular activity is the Foreclosure Task Force, also known as the Countermeasures Committee, which serves as the acting Student Council for Abydos.

entries.name: FTF
entries.content:
Foreclosure Task Force, also known as the Countermeasures Committee, is one of and perhaps the only School Club in Abydos High School which serves as the acting Student Council for Abydos.
